description: This file defines the interface DepositAccountReadPlatformService, which provides methods for reading deposit account data, transactions, templates, and related information within the savings portfolio module of the Fineract system.

classes.name: DepositAccountReadPlatformService
classes.description: Interface defining the service for reading deposit account information and transactions within the savings module.

methods.name: retrieveAll
methods.description: Retrieves all deposit accounts of a specified type, with pagination support.

methods.name: retrieveAllPaged
methods.description: Retrieves all deposit accounts of a specified type, returning a paginated result.

methods.name: retrieveAllForLookup
methods.description: Retrieves deposit accounts of a specific type for lookup purposes.

methods.name: retrieveOne
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific deposit account by ID and type.

methods.name: retrieveOneWithClosureTemplate
methods.description: Retrieves a deposit account with an associated closure template.

methods.name: retrieveOneWithChartSlabs
methods.description: Retrieves deposit account data along with chart slabs for a given product.

methods.name: retrieveAllTransactions
methods.description: Retrieves all transactions for a specific deposit account.

methods.name: retrieveTemplate
methods.description: Retrieves a deposit account template based on client, group, and product IDs with an option for staff office filtering.

methods.name: retrieveForMaturityUpdate
methods.description: Returns deposit accounts due for maturity updates.

methods.name: retrieveRecurringAccountDepositTransactionTemplate
methods.description: Provides a template for recurring deposit account transactions.

methods.name: retrieveDataForInterestTransfer
methods.description: Retrieves data necessary for processing interest transfers.

methods.name: retriveDataForRDScheduleCreation
methods.description: Retrieves data for recurring deposit schedule creation.
